highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 4.154.0 updates the bundled renderer to Skia m154 while retaining the new Graphite and asynchronous pixel-read capabilities.
highlights_body: It carries forward improved native package diagnostics, lifetime fixes, and Nano Server font support. Linux applications relying on implicit font fallback should review the breaking change below.

breaking.title: Linux font fallback may choose a different face
breaking.body: Skia now tries FcFontMatch before the previous FcFontSort fallback path, which can change selected glyphs or text metrics. Specify a family and style, or bundle a typeface, when deterministic font selection is required.

bullets.detail: Updates the bundled renderer with the m152, m153, and m154 engine lines and their upstream stability fixes.
Adds Graphite backend bindings for Vulkan, Metal, and Dawn, alongside a Vulkan Silk.NET package for applications that use those integrations.
SKImage and SKSurface now expose backend-neutral asynchronous RequestReadPixels support.
Fixes use-after-free paths for SKRegion span iteration and SKPixmap subsets, and releases pixel memory when raster image creation fails.

bullets.lead: Runtime-effect and HarfBuzz resources released correctly
bullets.detail: Resetting runtime-effect uniforms now disposes the previous buffer, while non-memory-backed streams are released after conversion to HarfBuzz blobs.
Improves common data, text-tag, runtime-effect, and HarfBuzz shaping paths by removing avoidable copies, boxing, and allocations.

bullets.lead: Native diagnostics and font support improved
bullets.detail: Apple symbol packages are produced during packing, Android symbols receive deterministic identities, and Nano Server gains FreeType font support.

contributor_summaries.jeffska: Added FreeType-backed font support for Nano Server
contributor_summaries.mmitche: Improved initialization of the MSVC environment for native Windows builds
contributor_summaries.ramezgerges: Added Graphite GPU backend bindings for Vulkan, Metal, and Dawn

preview_summaries.v4.152.0-preview.1.1: Preview 1 introduced Graphite GPU bindings, asynchronous pixel reads, updated Skia engine fixes, and a set of lifetime and allocation improvements.
preview_summaries.v4.152.0-rc.1.26426.14: Release Candidate 1 added package diagnostics, Vulkan Silk.NET distribution, runtime-resource fixes, and the m152 servicing update.

harfbuzz_summary: Improves HarfBuzz shaping by avoiding a defensive feature-array copy and fixes stream ownership when creating blobs. Package documentation was also refreshed.
